name: Pleasant Hill Teen Council
org: Pleasant Hill Recreation and Park District
what_you_do: Help develop, plan and carry out events, classes, dances, sports and trips for teens.
who_can_apply: Teens in grades 6 to 12. The page does not list a residency or school rule.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: Not taking new members now. The 2027-2028 application will be posted in March 2027. You hear back in mid-August.
how_to_apply: The 2027-2028 application will be posted in March 2027. Questions: email the Youth Services Manager, Katrina Hunn. Her email link is on the program page.
notes: Meetings are on the 1st and 3rd Mondays of the month, 6:15 to 7:00 PM, at the Pleasant Hill Teen Center. The council does not meet on holidays.
